title: Nelson Mandela: I Don't Know If I Paralyzed You | Speechless Reaction Meme
description: An illustrated reaction meme inspired by Nelson Mandela's 21 June 1990 Nightline interview with Ted Koppel. Use when someone goes silent, is stunned by a question or has no answer. Meme concept: @theeALPHAMAN on X.
alt: Cartoon Nelson Mandela smiles and says 'I don't know if I paralyzed you' to a stunned Ted Koppel with his hands raised, replying 'No, no, no, no, no!'
creator: @theeALPHAMAN on X
inspiration: Nelson Mandela and Ted Koppel, ABC Nightline, 21 June 1990
note: The Koppel response is fictional. The illustration is not an archival image.
